harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired node1’s reservation utility for atomic, idempotent SQLite reservations on CentOS 5/Python 2.4. Existing data was preserved, concurrency and bounded lock behavior were verified, and the repair persisted across a confirmed node restart.
actions_performed: Replaced unavailable sqlite3 module usage with the installed legacy sqlite module.
Added atomic BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions with a five-second retry deadline.
Added positive-quantity validation, idempotent request replay, insufficient-stock rejection, and guarded stock decrements.
Verified competing requests cannot make stock negative and duplicate IDs decrement exactly once.
Restarted node1 once and confirmed its boot identity changed and the utility/database recovered.
Preserved CentOS 5.11, kernel 2.6.18-398.el5, stock=5, and reservation previous-request=2.

evidence.summary: The repaired script compiles under Python 2.4 and retained the same checksum after restart.

evidence.requirement: Preserve reservations, replay successful IDs, validate quantity, and reject insufficient stock
evidence.summary: Replay returned the prior quantity without decrementing; zero and excessive quantities failed; production data remained unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Competing requests keep remaining stock nonnegative
evidence.summary: Of two simultaneous quantity-4 requests against stock 5, one succeeded and one failed; remaining stock was 1 with zero negative rows.

evidence.requirement: Successful request ID decrements exactly once
evidence.summary: Two simultaneous calls using the same ID both returned the same result, created one reservation row, and reduced stock from 5 to 3 once.
Under an independently held write lock, the request exited with code 75 after five seconds and made no database changes.

Healthy baseline boot ID 4244d945-3e4d-4348-8000-000000000000 was captured, restart was acknowledged, boot ID changed to dc6bec76-a7d4-4be4-8000-000000000000, and post-restart compilation, database integrity, persisted data, and live replay all passed.
